verdicts.reason: A: the headline breaks with an orphaned 'here', the SOLSTICE wordmark drops below the headline, and a huge empty band separates the copy from a centred CTA that ignores the left-aligned text. The flavour chips are crammed at the bottom edge, tiny, touching each other and stacked out of order. B: the headline wraps better and the headline, brand, subline and CTA sit together as one block, so the reading order is stronger. Its flaws: the chips sit on top of the peach circle in the top-left, the BLOOD ORANGE chip text is microscopic, the chips have mismatched sizes and gaps, the middle third is dead space, and the CTA is centred while the copy is left-aligned.
